recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Create a portrait-first browser cooking simulator called **Dunder Muffin: Weekend Prep Simulator**. Preserve a one-thumb mobile time-management loop: left-side floating joystick moves a small chef avatar around a station-based playfield, and one right-side action button picks up ingredients, processes valid items, plates exact recipe combinations, and delivers the requested dish for +100 score and +10 seconds. The timer ends the level; score meeting the quota advances, otherwise retry.

Present the world as a satirical office breakroom inspired by cozy weekend prep energy: meeting memos are orders, morale quota is target score, vibes are points, the meeting clock is the timer, and the pickup window is a conference counter. Use cottagecore, garden, and Sanrio-soft visual language with a memo-chef focal avatar, pantry cubbies, potted herbs, sticky notes, rounded cream panels, blush/mint/gold palette, and meme-toned copy such as “its giving snacks” and “Pikachu vibes.” Keep controls large, readable, and safe for 4:7 to 9:16 mobile portrait screens.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
- genre: mobile-first canvas cooking simulator / time-management arcade.
- objective: produce the current order by gathering ingredients, processing them when required, assembling exact recipe combinations, and delivering finished dishes before time expires.
- input model: left-side floating drag joystick for movement; one right-side action button for pickup/process/plate/deliver/trash; start/next/retry buttons use normal taps/clicks.
- core loop: read order, move to ingredient station, action to pick up, process at chop/steam stations when valid, add items to plate, exact-match recipe collapses to a dish, deliver correct dish for score and time bonus, repeat until timer ends.
- fail/friction state: timer expiry ends the level; passing requires score >= target, failure offers retry; invalid actions simply do nothing or require repositioning.

## Protected Mechanics
- Joystick vector movement, chef speed, movement bounds, station proximity radius, single action button semantics, one-second processing lock, recipe transformations, exact assembly matching, +100 score and +10 seconds on delivery, timer-driven end state, and level target progression are preserved.

## Remix Direction
Dunder Muffin: Weekend Prep Simulator reframes the same cooking simulator as a cozy, satirical office breakroom weekend prep session. The focal actor is a tiny memo-chef cooking cottagecore morale snacks for office coworkers. Orders become meeting memos, score becomes vibes, target becomes morale quota, timer becomes the meeting clock, and the old diner scene becomes a garden-facing office breakroom with memo awning, pantry cubbies, and soft meme-tone feedback.
